Job Description
A forward-thinking technology and security organization is seeking a  Generative AI Prompt Engineer  to contribute to the development of AI-powered solutions supporting cybersecurity analysis, vulnerability discovery, and automated security testing efforts. This position is ideal for professionals who thrive in environments where experimentation, technical problem solving, and rapid iteration are key to success. 
The team leverages frontier language models and advanced prompting techniques to address real-world security challenges. The individual in this role will help create scalable AI-driven frameworks, improve model effectiveness, and support initiatives focused on identifying meaningful security findings through Generative AI technologies. 
Candidates who have successfully built AI solutions, developed complex prompt strategies, and applied AI capabilities to technical problem domains will be particularly well positioned for success. The environment is highly collaborative and focused on turning innovative ideas into practical capabilities. 
This is a  12-month contract opportunity  located in  Minneapolis, MN  with a  hybrid schedule requiring three days onsite per week . Required Skills & Experience    Advanced knowledge of Large Language Models and Generative AI platforms  Experience creating, testing, and optimizing sophisticated prompts for technical use cases  Proven ability to develop AI harnesses, prompt frameworks, or AI-powered workflows  Cybersecurity experience including vulnerability analysis, security testing, threat identification, or related disciplines  Understanding of application and infrastructure security concepts  Familiarity with DAST, SAST, penetration testing, or vulnerability management practices  Software engineering experience using Python, Go, .NET, or similar programming languages  Ability to evaluate model performance and improve outcomes through experimentation  Strong analytical thinking and troubleshooting skills  Effective verbal and written communication abilities
  Desired Skills & Experience    Background in AI-focused security research  Experience performing adversarial model testing or AI red-team activities  Knowledge of malware, threat intelligence, and cyber defense methodologies  Experience with PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Cloud SQL, or comparable database platforms  Familiarity with security monitoring, network analysis, and infrastructure risk assessment  Exposure to cloud-native environments  Kubernetes or GKE experience  Experience supporting enterprise-scale security programs
  What You Will Be Doing
 Daily Responsibilities     Build advanced prompts and prompting methodologies for AI-driven cybersecurity initiatives  Develop frameworks that enable consistent and repeatable AI testing processes  Utilize Generative AI technologies to support security investigations and vulnerability analysis  Experiment with prompting approaches to improve model accuracy and effectiveness  Assess responses generated by AI systems and identify valuable security insights  Work alongside security and engineering teams to refine and expand AI capabilities  Contribute to research efforts focused on frontier language model applications  Support the collection, organization, and operational use of AI-generated findings  Build proof-of-concepts and prototypes that can be expanded into scalable solutions  Stay informed on emerging trends across AI, machine learning, and cybersecurity
  The Offer    $76.14/hr - $85.80/hr W2   12-Month Contract   Hybrid Schedule (3 Days Onsite)   Minneapolis, Minnesota   Opportunity to work on advanced AI and cybersecurity initiatives  Exposure to emerging Generative AI technologies and enterprise-scale innovation  Collaborative team focused on research, experimentation, and real-world implementation
